card.name: Words leading up to consequences or risks
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected mention of impact, consequences, risk or care, such as 'fully evaluate', 'be used with great care', or 'Warnings and Pre(cautions)'. It fires on the word that sets up the outcome, not on the outcome itself.

modes.label: Evaluating impact
modes.description: Verbs or adverbs in general text that lead into impacts or ramifications of actions.
modes.example: in order to fully<< evaluate>> their potential impact in advance

modes.label: Caution wording in labels
modes.description: Words in drug-label text leading into care, hazard or precaution statements.
modes.example: Solutions containing sodium ions should<< be>> used with great care, if at all

modes.label: Anticipating fallout
modes.description: Words in news or policy text before effects or effects-related terms like air quality or opposition.
modes.example: had not fully analyzed the legal, tax and policy ramifications of the proposal or<< anticipated>> the widespread opposition

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying 'consequence', 'consequences' and 'repercussions' next.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about to talk about the consequences or effects of an action.
